title: Coating compound found in the Bent Pyramid

tellings.quote: We've also found coating compound within the bent pyramid that would have protected the limestone walls from the vitriolic chemical reaction

plain: A researcher named Geoffrey Drumm says on Jesse Michels' podcast that a coating compound has been found inside the Bent Pyramid, an ancient pyramid at Dahshur in Egypt. He says the coating would have protected the limestone walls from a harsh, corrosive chemical reaction, which, if true, would mean chemical processes were once run inside the pyramid.
